name: hbfd_rly_136_sn_fc

pin_regs.reason: F1 relay = ONE register stage at the pins by definition: i is captured by the stage register, o leaves it through the matched forwarding buffer; a pin register would add a cycle per hop and break the clk_out / o driver match (DIE-CLOCK F1)

structural_change: NATIVE-FIX3 rr1 (2026-10-18): rs -> ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 = registered reset relay (rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv, 2 sync + 1 relay flop) so the W-face rs pin drives 3 flops instead of the async clear of all 136 stage flops (closed hbfd_rly_136_sn_fc-fc2-02fc2ee56: routed native capture rs 198.8 ps > 190, NATIVE-3). Data path, outline, pin plan (rs on W) unchanged; stage release 3 clock edges after rs (as the > 256 b classes), assert async/immediate; 0 data cycles. Was: F1 forwarded-clock variant of hbfd_rly_136_SN (owner neighbour-relative clocking; DIE-CLOCK form F1): same ot_hbm_rly stage on clk_in, clk_out + every o through one kept BUFx12f each, data face 32.4 um (<= 6 pins/um; was 21.6), outline 32.4 x 21.6. fc2: the clk_out buffer input is held off the clk_in net through CTS and reconnected to the root (fc1: TritonCTS made it a tree sink, clk_in->clk_out 58 ps through CTS buffers); forwarded-hop min separation 85 / 55 ps (fc1 50 ps padded the 624 inputs: native capture 193.5)

job.purpose: HBM die F1 forwarded-clock relay hbfd_rly_136_SN_fc: register on clk_in, clk_out = kept BUFx12f, o through the same cell on the downstream face beside clk_out; i/clk_in upstream (S), o/clk_out downstream (N), rs W; 32.4 x 21.6 um, M5 cap
